nodes.name: prompt_polish.rs
nodes.summary: 'Housekeeper' LLM-backed Tauri commands: polishes user prompts, explains session steps, runs model health checks and token benchmarks, and parses free-form UI intent, all via OpenAI-compatible chat completion requests.

nodes.name: model_candidates
nodes.summary: Builds the ordered list of candidate models to try for a housekeeper LLM request, falling back through configured alternatives.

nodes.name: select_prompt_polish_model
nodes.summary: Selects which model should service a prompt-polish request based on the caller's configured account and model preferences.

nodes.name: select_prompt_polish_account
nodes.summary: Selects which stored key/account should be used to service a housekeeper LLM request.

nodes.name: chat_completions_url
nodes.summary: Builds the chat-completions endpoint URL for the selected provider/base URL.

nodes.name: models_url
nodes.summary: Builds the models-listing endpoint URL for the selected provider/base URL.

nodes.name: with_optional_bearer
nodes.summary: Attaches an Authorization bearer header to an HTTP request builder when a key value is present.

nodes.name: content_value_to_string
nodes.summary: Flattens a chat-completion message content value (which may be a string or an array of parts) into plain text.

nodes.name: strip_tagged_block_case_insensitive
nodes.summary: Removes a case-insensitive tagged block (e.g. <think>...</think>) from model output text.

nodes.name: strip_reasoning_artifacts
nodes.summary: Strips known reasoning/thinking artifacts that some models emit alongside their final answer.

nodes.name: normalized_short_input
nodes.summary: Normalizes short user input (trimmed, lowercased) for pattern matching.

nodes.name: is_greeting_like
nodes.summary: Detects whether the input text is a simple greeting rather than an actionable task.

nodes.name: is_identity_question
nodes.summary: Detects whether the input text is a question about the assistant's identity rather than an actionable task.

nodes.name: is_capability_question
nodes.summary: Detects whether the input text is a question about the assistant's capabilities rather than an actionable task.

nodes.name: is_prompt_polish_quality_request
nodes.summary: Detects whether the input is itself a request to improve prompt-polish output quality.

nodes.name: known_task_expansion_fallback
nodes.summary: Returns a canned, expanded prompt for a small set of well-known task categories when the model output is too terse.

nodes.name: contains_request_signal
nodes.summary: Checks whether text contains language signaling an explicit request/ask.

nodes.name: looks_like_chatty_polish_output
nodes.summary: Heuristically detects when a polished prompt sounds too conversational/chatty rather than a direct instruction.

nodes.name: looks_like_underexpanded_generic_task
nodes.summary: Heuristically detects when the model's polished output under-expands a generic task description.

nodes.name: looks_like_direct_answer
nodes.summary: Heuristically detects when the model answered the question directly instead of producing a polished prompt.

nodes.name: looks_like_prompt_meta_output
nodes.summary: Heuristically detects when the model output talks about prompting itself rather than producing the polished prompt.

nodes.name: fallback_polish_for_short_answer
nodes.summary: Builds a fallback polished prompt when the model's own output was too short to be useful.

nodes.name: sanitize_polished_text
nodes.summary: Cleans up a model-produced polished prompt by trimming quotes/whitespace and stripping meta commentary.

nodes.name: build_polish_user_prompt
nodes.summary: Builds the user-role prompt sent to the LLM for the prompt-polish request.

nodes.name: text_excerpt
nodes.summary: Truncates text to a bounded number of words/characters for inclusion in a downstream prompt.

nodes.name: json_excerpt
nodes.summary: Serializes a value to JSON and truncates it to a bounded excerpt for inclusion in a downstream prompt.

nodes.name: build_step_explain_user_prompt
nodes.summary: Builds the user-role prompt sent to the LLM for the session-step-explanation request.

nodes.name: sanitize_step_explanation
nodes.summary: Cleans up a model-produced step explanation by trimming and stripping meta commentary.

nodes.name: requested_housekeeper_actions
nodes.summary: Filters a set of requested housekeeper action ids down to those the caller is allowed to invoke.

nodes.name: build_ui_intent_user_prompt
nodes.summary: Builds the user-role prompt sent to the LLM to classify free-form UI intent into an allowed action.

nodes.name: extract_first_json_object
nodes.summary: Scans model output text and extracts the first well-formed JSON object it contains.

nodes.name: chat_choices_text
nodes.summary: Extracts the text content from every choice in a chat-completion response.

nodes.name: parse_ui_intent_response
nodes.summary: Parses the model's JSON UI-intent classification response into a HousekeeperUiIntentResponse.

nodes.name: extract_model_max_len
nodes.summary: Extracts a model's maximum context length from a models-listing API response.

nodes.name: extract_polished_text
nodes.summary: Extracts the final polished-prompt text from a chat-completion response.

nodes.name: extract_step_explanation
nodes.summary: Extracts the final step-explanation text from a chat-completion response.

nodes.name: provider_error_message
nodes.summary: Extracts a human-readable error message from a provider's error response body.

nodes.name: build_context_summary_user_prompt
nodes.summary: Builds the user-role prompt sent to the LLM to summarize session context for the housekeeper.

nodes.name: request_housekeeper_context_summary
nodes.summary: Sends a chat-completion request to summarize housekeeper context and returns the parsed response.

nodes.name: request_prompt_polish
nodes.summary: Sends the chat-completion request that performs prompt polishing and returns the raw response.

nodes.name: request_session_step_explain
nodes.summary: Sends the chat-completion request that explains a session step and returns the raw response.

nodes.name: request_housekeeper_health_check
nodes.summary: Sends chat-completion request(s) that exercise a model to determine its health status for the housekeeper.

nodes.name: request_housekeeper_token_benchmark
nodes.summary: Sends a chat-completion request while measuring latency/throughput to benchmark a model's token generation speed.

nodes.name: request_housekeeper_ui_intent
nodes.summary: Sends the chat-completion request that classifies free-form UI intent and returns the raw response.

nodes.name: summarize_housekeeper_context
nodes.summary: Tauri command that summarizes housekeeper session context via an LLM request.

nodes.name: prompt_polish
nodes.summary: Tauri command that polishes a raw user prompt into a clearer, more actionable instruction using an LLM.

nodes.name: session_step_explain
nodes.summary: Tauri command that asks an LLM to explain what a given session step accomplished, in plain language.

nodes.name: housekeeper_health_check
nodes.summary: Tauri command that runs a health check against a configured model to confirm it responds correctly.

nodes.name: housekeeper_token_benchmark
nodes.summary: Tauri command that benchmarks a model's token generation throughput/latency.

nodes.name: housekeeper_ui_intent
nodes.summary: Tauri command that classifies a free-form user instruction into one of the allowed housekeeper UI actions.

nodes.name: PromptPolishRequest
nodes.summary: Request payload for the prompt_polish Tauri command.

nodes.name: PromptPolishResponse
nodes.summary: Response payload containing the polished prompt text.

nodes.name: SessionStepExplainRequest
nodes.summary: Request payload for the session_step_explain Tauri command.

nodes.name: SessionStepExplainResponse
nodes.summary: Response payload containing the generated step explanation.

nodes.name: HousekeeperHealthCheckRequest
nodes.summary: Request payload for the housekeeper_health_check Tauri command.

nodes.name: HousekeeperHealthCheckResponse
nodes.summary: Response payload reporting the outcome of a housekeeper model health check.

nodes.name: HousekeeperTokenBenchmarkRequest
nodes.summary: Request payload for the housekeeper_token_benchmark Tauri command.

nodes.name: HousekeeperTokenBenchmarkResponse
nodes.summary: Response payload reporting measured token throughput/latency for a model.

nodes.name: HousekeeperUiContext
nodes.summary: Contextual UI state passed to the housekeeper when classifying user intent.

nodes.name: HousekeeperUiIntentRequest
nodes.summary: Request payload for the housekeeper_ui_intent Tauri command.
